title.en: Control charts for attributes: p, np and c charts
title.kn: ಗುಣಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು: p, np ಮತ್ತು c ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು

heading.en: Good or bad, and how many flaws?

hook.en: Some qualities cannot be measured, only judged: a bulb lights or it does not; a sari has a few weaving flaws or none. For such attributes we chart the proportion defective (p chart), the number defective (np chart) or the number of defects (c chart).
hook.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಗುಣಗಳನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯಲಾಗದು, ತೀರ್ಮಾನಿಸಬಹುದು ಅಷ್ಟೇ: ಬಲ್ಬ್ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ ಅಥವಾ ಇಲ್ಲ; ಸೀರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲವು ನೇಯ್ಗೆ ದೋಷಗಳಿವೆ ಅಥವಾ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಇಂತಹ ಗುಣಗಳಿಗೆ p, np ಮತ್ತು c ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

objectives.en: Construct a p chart and an np chart
Choose the right chart for the data

narration.en: Some qualities cannot be measured, only judged: a bulb lights or it does not; a sari has a few weaving flaws or none. For such attributes we chart the proportion defective (p chart), the number defective (np chart) or the number of defects (c chart).
narration.kn: ಕೆಲವು ಗುಣಗಳನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯಲಾಗದು, ತೀರ್ಮಾನಿಸಬಹುದು ಅಷ್ಟೇ: ಬಲ್ಬ್ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ ಅಥವಾ ಇಲ್ಲ; ಸೀರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲವು ನೇಯ್ಗೆ ದೋಷಗಳಿವೆ ಅಥವಾ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಇಂತಹ ಗುಣಗಳಿಗೆ p, np ಮತ್ತು c ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

body.en: When each item is classed as defective or not, with $k$ samples of size $n$: $\bar{p} = \dfrac{\text{total defectives}}{\text{total inspected}}$. p chart (fraction defective): $CL = \bar{p}$, limits $\bar{p} \pm 3\sqrt{\dfrac{\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})}{n}}$. np (or d) chart (number defective): $CL = n\bar{p}$, limits $n\bar{p} \pm 3\sqrt{n\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})}$. A negative LCL is taken as 0.
body.kn: ದೋಷಯುಕ್ತ/ದೋಷರಹಿತ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ p̄ = ಒಟ್ಟು ದೋಷಯುಕ್ತ / ಒಟ್ಟು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿತ. p ನಕ್ಷೆ: p̄ ± 3√(p̄q̄/n). np ನಕ್ಷೆ: np̄ ± 3√(np̄q̄). ಋಣ LCL ಅನ್ನು 0 ಎಂದು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

narration.en: When each item is classed as defective or not, with k samples of size n: p = dfractexttotal defectivestexttotal inspected. p chart (fraction defective): CL = p, limits p ± 3rootdfracp(1-p)n. np (or d) chart (number defective): CL = np, limits np ± 3rootnp(1-p). A negative LCL is taken as 0.
narration.kn: ದೋಷಯುಕ್ತ/ದೋಷರಹಿತ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ p̄ = ಒಟ್ಟು ದೋಷಯುಕ್ತ / ಒಟ್ಟು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿತ. p ನಕ್ಷೆ: p̄ ± 3√(p̄q̄/n). np ನಕ್ಷೆ: np̄ ± 3√(np̄q̄). ಋಣ LCL ಅನ್ನು 0 ಎಂದು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

narration.en: The teacher finds c̄ from ten cloth pieces, computes the limits and plots the defect counts.

say.en: Defects in ten pieces of cloth: 2, 4, 3, 1, 5, 3, 6, 2, 4, 0. The total is 30, so c bar is 3.
Limits are c bar plus or minus 3 root c bar: 3 plus 5.20 is 8.20; 3 minus 5.20 is negative, so the LCL is 0.
Draw the central line and the upper limit.
Plot the counts. Every point is below 8.2, so the process is in control.

body.en: When we count defects in a unit (a unit may have several defects), the number of defects $c$ follows a Poisson distribution, whose mean and variance are equal. With $\bar{c}$ = average number of defects per unit: $CL = \bar{c}$, $UCL = \bar{c} + 3\sqrt{\bar{c}}$, $LCL = \bar{c} - 3\sqrt{\bar{c}}$ (0 if negative). Examples: flaws in a glass sheet, rivets missing on an aircraft wing, typing errors per page.
body.kn: ಒಂದು ಘಟಕದಲ್ಲಿನ ದೋಷಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ c ಪಾಯ್ಸನ್ ವಿತರಣೆ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತದೆ. c ನಕ್ಷೆ: CL = c̄, UCL = c̄ + 3√c̄, LCL = c̄ − 3√c̄ (ಋಣವಾದರೆ 0).

points.en: Defective item vs number of defects

narration.en: When we count defects in a unit (a unit may have several defects), the number of defects c follows a Poisson distribution, whose mean and variance are equal. With c = average number of defects per unit: CL = c, UCL = c + 3rootc, LCL = c - 3rootc (0 if negative). Examples: flaws in a glass sheet, rivets missing on an aircraft wing, typing errors per page.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಘಟಕದಲ್ಲಿನ ದೋಷಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ c ಪಾಯ್ಸನ್ ವಿತರಣೆ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತದೆ. c ನಕ್ಷೆ: CL = c̄, UCL = c̄ + 3√c̄, LCL = c̄ − 3√c̄ (ಋಣವಾದರೆ 0).

caption.en: p chart UCL against the sample size n. Slide p̄: larger samples give narrower limits.

narration.en: Move the average fraction defective and watch how the upper control limit falls as the sample size grows.

tryThis.en: At p̄ = 0.05, what n first gives a positive LCL?
Compare the UCL at n = 50 and n = 200.
Check that np chart UCL = n × p chart UCL.

problem.en: Ten samples of 100 items had defectives 5, 3, 6, 2, 8, 4, 3, 7, 5, 7. Find the control limits of the p chart and comment.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Ten samples of 100 items had defectives 5, 3, 6, 2, 8, 4, 3, 7, 5, 7. Find the control limits of the p chart and comment.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, then the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the pattern of the II PUC Statistics board exam. Try them on your own first, then check.

homework.en: Distinguish between a defect and a defective. Which chart suits each?

narration.en: Recap. p chart: p̄ ± 3√(p̄q̄/n). np chart: np̄ ± 3√(np̄q̄). c chart: c̄ ± 3√c̄ (Poisson). Negative LCL is taken as 0.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. p ನಕ್ಷೆ: p̄ ± 3√(p̄q̄/n). np ನಕ್ಷೆ: np̄ ± 3√(np̄q̄). c ನಕ್ಷೆ: c̄ ± 3√c̄ (ಪಾಯ್ಸನ್). ಋಣ LCL ಅನ್ನು 0 ಎಂದು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
